name: agentic-sdlc
description: AI-assisted SDLC pipelines for ANDROID development (Kotlin + Gradle) in Claude Code. Android Foundation is the centerpiece stack provider; it embeds its own additive framework providers (Retrofit, Ktor, Room, Proto DataStore, Dagger/Hilt, Koin, WorkManager — ADR-0026) via manifest.yaml's `frameworks:` array, resolved by the same conditional-activation mechanism (kind: foundation | framework) the Stack Provider Pattern always used. The generic sdlc core owns the pipeline. Adapted from AratKruglik/claude-sdlc (MIT).

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Platform-agnostic SDLC orchestrator with stack-provider auto-discovery. Provides the pipeline-orchestrator skill (generic phases, review-loops, parallel groups, workflow discovery across plugins, file_glob/nested detection) plus the whole 12-agent roster (ADR-0021): BA Opus/high, developer/reviewer/tester/qa-engineer Sonnet/medium with iteration caps, security-analyst Opus/high read-only, document-writer Haiku/low, debugger read-only, devops, cicd, aar-analyst, session-recorder. Foundations supply per-role expertise (role_expertise) that is rendered into each agent's stable prefix. Commands: /sdlc:start, /sdlc:doctor, /sdlc:list-stacks, /sdlc:batch, /sdlc:security-init.

plugins.name: android-foundation
plugins.description: Android Foundation — the centerpiece stack provider (Kotlin + Gradle, aspect android, priority 300, auto-detected via Gradle-AND-Kotlin). Ships NO agents (ADR-0021): the roster is the core's, and this plugin declares the Android EXPERTISE those core roles consume — role_expertise for all 11 roles (invariants, rule paths, mandatory skills) plus 20 skills: android-requirements, android-review, android-security-masvs (MASVS/MASTG), android-testing, android-e2e, android-docs-vault, android-debugging, android-build-release, android-ci, the four convention skills for Compose UI, architecture, data and Navigation, and the seven embedded framework-conventions skills (ADR-0026): retrofit, ktor, room, datastore, hilt, koin, workmanager. Frameworks are declared inline via manifest.yaml's `frameworks:` array — one row per additive library, each carrying its own `enriches_aspect` + `dependency` for conditional activation (retrofit/ktor on `network`, room/datastore-proto on `persistence`, dagger/koin on `di`, workmanager on `background` — only the detected provider per aspect activates). Plugin-resident rules, optional Obsidian vault (manage-vault skill), optional Android CLI advisory, ktlint/detekt + non-negotiable hooks. Carries pinned house rules (Coil3, Kermit, KSP, @Serializable routes, DataStore, Play Billing). Workflow android-feature: BA->Dev->Review(<->Dev x3)->[Security||Test]->QA->Docs, auto-selected on Android projects.
